en: Run a full health check of this server: CPU, memory, swap, disks, load, uptime, failed services and recent kernel errors. Rate the risk and say what to do.
zh: 对这台服务器做一次全面健康检查：CPU、内存、交换区、磁盘、负载、运行时间、失败的服务和最近的内核错误，给出风险等级和处理建议。

en: The server has been slow lately. Find out why: look at the load, CPU, memory, I/O wait and the busiest processes, then give a conclusion and what to optimize.
zh: 服务器最近变慢了，请找出原因：查看负载、CPU、内存、I/O 等待和占用最高的进程，给出结论和优化建议。

en: List this server's OS version, kernel, CPU model and cores, memory, disks, IP addresses and uptime.
zh: 列出这台服务器的系统版本、内核、CPU 型号和核数、内存、磁盘、IP 地址和运行时间。

en: Look at the system's errors of the last 24 hours (journalctl -p err, dmesg), group them, and explain the main problems and their likely causes.
zh: 查看最近 24 小时的系统错误日志（journalctl -p err、dmesg），归纳主要问题并说明可能的原因。

en: List every systemd service that failed or misbehaves, and for each say why and how to fix it.
zh: 列出所有启动失败或运行异常的 systemd 服务，逐个说明失败原因和修复办法。

en: Did this server reboot recently? Look at the reboot records and the logs before the last shutdown, and tell whether it was a normal reboot, a power loss or a kernel crash.
zh: 服务器最近重启过吗？请查看重启记录和上次关机前的日志，判断是正常重启、断电还是内核崩溃。

en: CPU usage is high. Find the processes and threads using the most CPU, explain why, and say what to do.
zh: CPU 使用率很高，请找出占用 CPU 最多的进程和线程，分析原因并给出处理建议。

en: Memory is tight. Analyze its use: the processes using the most, the cache and swap, any sign of a leak, and how to improve it.
zh: 内存紧张，请分析内存使用：哪些进程占用最多、缓存和交换区情况、是否有内存泄漏迹象，并给出优化建议。

en: Check whether disk I/O is the bottleneck: which processes read and write the most, and the I/O wait. Give advice.
zh: 检查磁盘 I/O 是否成为瓶颈：哪些进程读写最多、I/O 等待时间，给出建议。

en: The load is high but the CPU is not busy. Look for processes stuck in I/O or in the D state, and explain why.
zh: 负载高但 CPU 不高
负载很高但 CPU 使用率不高，请排查是否有进程卡在 I/O 或 D 状态，并说明原因。

en: Check whether the OOM killer killed processes recently: which ones, and how to avoid it.
zh: 检查最近是否有进程因内存不足被 OOM Killer 杀掉，说明是哪些进程以及如何避免。

en: From what this server does and has, check the usual kernel parameters (open files, TCP, swappiness…) and suggest better values; explain the effect before changing anything.
zh: 根据这台服务器的用途和配置，检查常见内核参数（文件句柄、TCP、swappiness 等）并给出优化建议，修改前先说明影响。

en: The disk is almost full. Find the biggest directories and files (logs, caches and Docker's data included), list what can be cleaned safely, and ask me before cleaning.
zh: 磁盘空间快满了，请找出占用最大的目录和文件（包括日志、缓存、Docker 数据），列出可以安全清理的项目，清理前先征得我同意。

en: Find the files over 500 MB on this server, sorted by size, and say which may be deleted.
zh: 找出这台服务器上大于 500MB 的文件，按大小排序列出，并说明哪些可能可以删除。

en: Check whether a file system ran out of inodes, and find the directories with the most small files.
zh: 检查是否有分区的 inode 用尽，找出小文件最多的目录。

en: Clean old logs safely: look at what the journal and /var/log take, and set a sensible retention.
zh: 帮我安全地清理旧日志：查看 journal 和 /var/log 的占用，并设置合理的保留策略。

en: Show the disks not mounted yet, and guide me to format one, mount it and add it to fstab to mount at boot, confirming each step.
zh: 帮我查看未挂载的磁盘，并指导我格式化、挂载并写入 fstab 实现开机自动挂载（每一步执行前先确认）。

en: Check the disks' health and file system errors (SMART, I/O errors in dmesg), and conclude.
zh: 检查磁盘的健康状态和文件系统错误（SMART、dmesg 中的 I/O 错误），给出结论。

en: List every listening port and its process, and point out which are open to the internet and whether that is a risk.
zh: 列出所有监听的端口和对应的进程，指出哪些端口对公网开放、是否存在风险。

en: Troubleshoot the network: DNS resolution, the default gateway, access to the internet and the latency.
zh: 帮我排查网络连通性：DNS 解析、默认网关、外网访问和延迟。

en: Port [port] cannot be reached from outside. Check whether the service listens, the firewall and the cloud security group.
zh: 端口【端口号】从外部无法访问，请排查服务是否在监听、防火墙和云安全组等原因。

en: Count the TCP connections by state (ESTABLISHED, TIME_WAIT…) and the source IPs with the most.
zh: 统计当前 TCP 连接的状态分布（ESTABLISHED、TIME_WAIT 等）和连接最多的来源 IP。

en: Test this server's latency and packet loss to common regions.
zh: 测试这台服务器到常见地区的网络延迟和丢包情况。

en: Check that the DNS settings are right and names resolve, and suggest changes if needed.
zh: 检查 DNS 配置是否正确、域名解析是否正常，必要时给出修改建议。

en: Audit this server's security: the SSH settings, open ports, suspicious logins and processes, files with weak permissions and security updates to install. Order the findings by risk.
zh: 对这台服务器做一次安全检查：SSH 配置、开放端口、可疑登录、可疑进程、权限过宽的文件和待安装的安全更新，按风险排序给出建议。

en: Check for recent SSH brute-force attempts, count their source IPs, and suggest a defense (such as fail2ban).
zh: 检查最近是否有 SSH 暴力破解尝试，统计来源 IP，并给出防护建议（如 fail2ban）。

en: Harden SSH: turn off password and direct root logins, change the port and so on. Explain each step's effect first, and make sure I cannot be locked out.
zh: 帮我加固 SSH：禁用密码登录和 root 直接登录、修改端口等。执行前说明每一步的影响，并确保不会把我锁在外面。

en: Check whether the server was broken into or runs a crypto miner: unusual processes, cron jobs, startup items and network connections.
zh: 排查服务器是否被入侵或植入挖矿程序：异常进程、定时任务、启动项、可疑网络连接。

en: Show the recent logins and failed login attempts, and mark the suspicious sources.
zh: 查看最近的登录记录和失败的登录尝试，标出可疑的来源。

en: Look for executables changed recently, SUID files, and suspicious files in /tmp.
zh: 检查系统中最近修改过的可执行文件、SUID 文件和 /tmp 中的可疑文件。

en: List the users who can log in, their sudo rights and when they last logged in.
zh: 列出系统中所有可以登录的用户、sudo 权限和最近登录时间。

en: Create a user [name], with sudo rights and SSH key login.
zh: 帮我创建一个新用户【用户名】，配置 sudo 权限和 SSH 公钥登录。

en: The permissions of [path] are wrong. Check its owner and mode and say how to fix them.
zh: 目录【路径】的权限有问题，请检查属主和权限并给出修复方法。

en: Check that the sudoers settings are safe, and whether any sudo needs no password.
zh: 检查 sudoers 配置是否安全，是否有免密 sudo。

en: The service [name] does not start. Look at its status and logs, find why and fix it.
zh: 服务【服务名】无法启动，请查看它的状态和日志，找出原因并修复。

en: Make [service] start at boot, and check the setup.
zh: 帮我把【服务名】设置为开机自启，并确认配置正确。

en: Turn the command [command] into a systemd service that starts at boot and restarts when it crashes.
zh: 帮我把命令【命令】做成 systemd 服务，支持开机自启和崩溃后自动重启。

en: Show how the process [name] runs: its PID, start time, CPU and memory, and the ports and files it has open.
zh: 查看进程【进程名】的运行情况：PID、启动时间、CPU 和内存占用、打开的端口和文件。

en: Look for zombie processes or ones that stopped responding long ago, and say how to deal with them.
zh: 检查是否有僵尸进程或长时间无响应的进程，并说明处理方法。

en: Analyze the recent system logs: find the errors and warnings, group them, and explain their causes.
zh: 分析最近的系统日志，找出错误和警告，归纳成几类并说明原因。

en: Analyze the Nginx access log: the IPs and URLs with the most requests, the status codes, odd requests and possible attacks.
zh: 分析 Nginx 访问日志
分析 Nginx 访问日志：访问量最多的 IP 和 URL、状态码分布、异常请求和可能的攻击。

en: Look at the error log of [app], find its recent errors and suggest fixes.
zh: 查看应用【应用名】的错误日志，找出最近的报错并给出修复建议。

en: Show the last 100 lines of [service]'s log and explain the problems in them.
zh: 帮我查看【服务名】最新的 100 行日志，并解释其中的问题。

en: List every container with its state, resources, ports and restart count, and point out those with problems.
zh: 列出所有容器的状态、资源占用、端口映射和重启次数，指出有问题的容器。

en: The container [name] keeps restarting. Look at its logs and settings and find why.
zh: 容器【容器名】一直在重启，请查看日志和配置找出原因。

en: Show the disk space Docker takes, and the images, containers, volumes and build cache that can be removed safely (ask me first).
zh: 查看 Docker 占用的磁盘空间，找出可以安全清理的镜像、容器、卷和构建缓存（清理前先确认）。

en: Install the latest Docker and Docker Compose on this server, starting at boot.
zh: 帮我在这台服务器上安装最新的 Docker 和 Docker Compose，并设置开机自启。

en: Write a docker-compose.yml for [app], with its data kept in volumes and restarting by itself.
zh: 帮我为【应用】写一个 docker-compose.yml，包含数据持久化和自动重启。

en: Set up a registry mirror for Docker and limit the size of its logs.
zh: 帮我配置 Docker 镜像加速，并限制容器日志的大小。

en: The site [domain] does not open. Check layer by layer: DNS, firewall, web server and backend.
zh: 网站【域名】打不开，请从 DNS、防火墙、Web 服务、后端进程逐层排查原因。

en: Check the Nginx configuration for syntax errors and common problems (security headers, gzip, timeouts), and suggest improvements.
zh: 检查 Nginx 配置是否有语法错误和常见问题（安全头、gzip、超时），并给出优化建议。

en: Set up an Nginx reverse proxy from [domain] to local port [port], with HTTPS.
zh: 帮我配置 Nginx 反向代理，把【域名】转发到本机端口【端口】，并支持 HTTPS。

en: The site answers 502 or 504. Check the backend, the timeouts and the logs.
zh: 网站出现 502/504 错误，请排查后端服务、超时设置和日志。

en: Install and start Nginx, with a default site.
zh: 帮我安装并启动 Nginx，配置一个默认站点。

en: Check MySQL or MariaDB: its state, connections, slow queries and key settings, and suggest improvements.
zh: 检查 MySQL/MariaDB 的运行状态、连接数、慢查询和关键配置，给出优化建议。

en: Write a backup script for the database [name] that keeps 7 daily copies, and add it to cron.
zh: 帮我写一个数据库【库名】的备份脚本，按天保留 7 份，并加入定时任务。

en: Analyze MySQL's slow query log, find the slowest statements and suggest indexes.
zh: 分析 MySQL 慢查询日志，找出最慢的语句并给出索引优化建议。

en: Check Redis: its memory, persistence, connections and security settings.
zh: 检查 Redis 的内存使用、持久化配置、连接数和安全设置。

en: Check PostgreSQL: its state, connections, database sizes and key settings.
zh: 检查 PostgreSQL 的运行状态、连接数、数据库大小和关键配置。

en: List every user's crontab and the systemd timers, and explain what each job does.
zh: 列出所有用户的 crontab 和 systemd 定时器，解释每个任务的作用。

en: Back up [path] to [destination] every night, keeping the last 7 days, with a cron job.
zh: 帮我把目录【路径】每天凌晨备份到【目标位置】，保留最近 7 天，并加入定时任务。

en: The scheduled job [job] did not run on time. Find why.
zh: 定时任务【任务】没有按时执行，请排查原因。

en: Sync [source] to [destination] with rsync, showing a dry run first.
zh: 帮我用 rsync 把【源目录】同步到【目标】，先演示一次不实际执行的预览。

en: Check the system and security updates to install, and whether a reboot is needed.
zh: 检查有哪些系统更新和安全更新可以安装，说明是否需要重启。

en: Install [software] and set it up, saying where it is and how to use it.
zh: 帮我安装【软件名】并完成基本配置，说明安装位置和使用方法。

en: The package sources fail or are slow. Check them and switch to a suitable mirror.
zh: 软件源无法更新或速度很慢，请检查并换成合适的国内镜像源。

en: Install a [Node.js / Python / Go / Java] development environment, with its environment variables.
zh: 帮我安装【Node.js / Python / Go / Java】开发环境，并配置好环境变量。

en: Check when this server's site certificates expire, and list those expiring within 30 days.
zh: 检查本机网站证书的到期时间，列出 30 天内到期的证书。

en: Get a free Let's Encrypt certificate for [domain] with certbot, renewing by itself.
zh: 帮我用 certbot 为【域名】申请 Let's Encrypt 免费证书，并配置自动续期。

en: Browsers report a certificate error for [domain]. Check the chain, the names and the expiry.
zh: 访问【域名】时提示证书错误，请检查证书链、域名和过期时间。

en: List the firewall rules (ufw, firewalld, iptables or nftables) and say which ports are open.
zh: 列出当前的防火墙规则（ufw / firewalld / iptables / nftables），说明哪些端口是开放的。

en: Open port [port] in the firewall, and check it took effect.
zh: 帮我在防火墙中开放端口【端口】，并确认生效。

en: Block the IP [address] in the firewall, and check it took effect.
zh: 帮我在防火墙中封禁 IP【IP 地址】，并确认生效。

en: Write a command that: [what it should do]
zh: 帮我写一条命令：【描述你要做的事】

en: Explain what each part of this command does, and its risks: [command]
zh: 解释这条命令每个部分的作用和风险：【命令】

en: Write a shell script that [does what], handling errors, with comments.
zh: 帮我写一个 Shell 脚本，实现【功能】，要求有错误处理和注释。

en: [Rename / compress / convert] the files in [path] in bulk, showing a preview first.
zh: 帮我批量【重命名 / 压缩 / 转换】目录【路径】中的文件，先给出预览。
